name: AnythingLLM

install server and collector dependencies (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 for the collector)

DISABLE_TELEMETRY="true"
' "$HOME/anything-llm/server/storage" >> server/.env.development && yarn prisma:setup

yarn setup ran past 600 s. It hung in the collector's 'Building fresh packages' step (most likely the Puppeteer Chrome download). Installing the collector with PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 finished in 5 s. The frontend install and build were skipped because the box has no GUI.
Add STORAGE_DIR (an absolute path to server/storage) to server/.env.development, then run yarn prisma:setup

what_it_does.quote: Connect your favorite local or cloud LLM, ingest your documents, and start chatting in minutes. Out of the box you get built-in agents, multi-user support, vector databases, and document pipelines

who_it_is_for.quote: AnythingLLM is the all-in-one AI application that lets you build a private, fully-featured ChatGPT—without compromises.

first_run_example.quote: AnythingLLM should now be running on `http://localhost:3001`!

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote: To update AnythingLLM with future updates you can `git pull origin master` to pull in the latest code and then repeat steps 2 - 5 to deploy with all changes fully.
